name: 7 Wonders
description: Draft cards over three ages to build a city and a wonder (2nd edition). Leaders, Cities and the Wonder Pack are add-on packs. Private local build: not for distribution.

sideB.title: Play the B side of every wonder
sideB.description: Otherwise every wonder is on its A side.

randomSides.title: Random wonder sides
randomSides.description: Each wonder's side is drawn at random (overrides the B side option).

teamPlay.title: Team play
teamPlay.description: 4, 6 or 8 players in adjacent pairs: teammates do not fight, conflict tokens are doubled. Seats stay individual in the result.

startCoins.title: Starting coins
startCoins.description: Coins each city starts with (the Leaders add-on presets 6).
